keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Brian Schwake (Nashville SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Obinna Nwobodo (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card.
Evander (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card.
Samuel Gidi (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Miles Robinson replaces Teenage Hadebe.
Second Half begins FC Cincinnati 0, Nashville SC 0.
Goal! FC Cincinnati 0, Nashville SC 1. Sam Surridge (Nashville SC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Andy Nájar with a through ball.
Kyle Smith (FC Cincinnati) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, FC Cincinnati. Kenji Mboma Dem replaces Tom Barlow.
